summary.zh: 会话预测七日由219升至248，但拟合度仅0.435；跳出率持平，结局转化为5.8%。
summary.en: Sessions are forecast to rise from 219 to 248 over seven days, but fit is modest (R² 0.435); bounce is flat and ending conversion is 5.8%.

riskiestCohort.zh: 账本页高频连点者，点击率达53.0%。
riskiestCohort.en: Ledger-page visitors generating repeated clicks; rage-click rate is 53.0%.

actions.actionZh: 修复游记账本页连点控件的状态与跳转反馈。
actions.actionEn: Fix control states and navigation feedback on the ledger story page.
actions.rationaleZh: 当前213次点击、402次浏览，点击率53.0%；验收降至不高于30%。
actions.rationaleEn: Baseline: 213 clicks per 402 views, a 53.0% rate; acceptance target: at most 30%.
actions.riskZh: 若连点属于正常操作，可能误伤有效交互。
actions.riskEn: If repeated clicks are intentional, valid interactions could be impaired.

actions.actionZh: 在世界入口显著呈现游记与谱册入口，并记录打开事件。
actions.actionEn: Make the journal and scorebook entry prominent in-world and log open events.
actions.rationaleZh: 进入世界后仅1038/2386打开游记或谱册，转化43.5%；验收达到50%。
actions.rationaleEn: Only 1,038 of 2,386 world entries open a journal or scorebook, a 43.5% rate; target 50%.
actions.metric: 进入世界→打开游记/谱册转化率
actions.riskZh: 入口过度突出可能遮挡世界内容。
actions.riskEn: An overly prominent entry could obscure world content.

actions.actionZh: 在正文读完页加入明确的抵达结局操作入口。
actions.actionEn: Add a clear path to the ending on completed-story pages.
actions.rationaleZh: 读完正文后289/680抵达结局，转化42.5%；验收达到50%。
actions.rationaleEn: 289 of 680 completed-story readers reach the ending, a 42.5% rate; target 50%.
actions.metric: 读完正文→抵达结局转化率
actions.riskZh: 过强提示可能削弱结局选择的自主感。
actions.riskEn: An overly forceful prompt could reduce perceived choice.

actions.actionZh: 定位压测慢端点并将其尾部响应纳入性能修复。
actions.actionEn: Identify slow stress-test endpoints and include tail latency in performance fixes.
actions.rationaleZh: 470次请求覆盖94个端点，失败为0，百分之九十五响应时间1445毫秒；验收低于1000毫秒且失败仍为0。
actions.rationaleEn: The 470-request, 94-endpoint test had zero failures and 1,445 ms p95 latency; target under 1,000 ms with zero failures.
actions.metric: 压测百分之九十五响应时间
actions.riskZh: 降低延迟的改动可能增加资源消耗或引入回归。
actions.riskEn: Latency changes may increase resource use or introduce regressions.

sensitivity.zh: 进入世界后打开游记或谱册仅43.5%，该步流失1348人，最值得盯紧。
sensitivity.en: Only 43.5% open a journal or scorebook after entering the world; this step loses 1,348 people.
